nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: For the last two months, Falun Gong communications channels have been full of videos swiped from Chinese social media of hospitals absolutely swamped with desperate looking parents holding sick kids.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: We also now have evidence of farmland being dug up for graves after nearly a decade of government pressure being applied to encourage cremation instead (I've written previously about the CCP's decree to maintain a minimum acreage of farmland for food security)

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: Per reports on social media in China - reports which get censored almost immediately - crematoriums in China have been swamped as well, with greatly increased demand for services.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: We've also seen comments from people working in the mortuary industry - specifically, those who manufacture coffins and caskets - that they have seen a boom in their sales.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text:
While other industries have seen a culling of businesses and massive pay backlogs of months or even years, the funeral industry in China is healthy.

Ba dum tiss

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text:
Every one of the diseases currently spreading in China are present here in the West.  None of them would be worthy of note if they weren't all hitting at the same time.

And this has made the Chinese people rather...conspiratorial.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text:
There are some WILD conspiracy theories flying on Chinese social media, including some that the CCP deliberately started spreading these diseases.

My person favorite is that this is actually being caused by the Sinovac COVID vaccine.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: Speaking of which, Sinovac is in serious financial trouble and may be on the verge of declaring bankruptcy.

nodes.author: QEInfinity1
nodes.text: @EricMertz_KC with $10bn in net cash on the balance sheet 🤣🤡 show. You might want to check on that one

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text:
The real issue, though, is one no one on Chinese social media seems to be addressing.

The nature of medical education in China.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: You see, in China, doctors are taught via rote memorization.  Questions are strongly discouraged.  And proper diagnostics isn't taught because it encourages free thinking.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: To make matters worse, roughly 1/3 of Chinese "doctors" exclusively practice quakery billed as "traditional Chinese medicine" and have strict guidelines handed down by the CCP on how and what to prescribe.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: This, by the way, is part of the reason we saw people keeling over in the streets in late 2019 and early 2020.  The other reasons being censorship and HORIFFIC levels of air pollution.
